title: Etz Chaim (The Tree of Life)
author: Chaim Vital (Sefaria Community trans)
description: Chaim Vital presents the teachings associated with Isaac Luria through a complex account of divine emanation and cosmic restoration. The Tree of Life is a major source for Lurianic Kabbalah and its understanding of creation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from Sefaria (https://www.sefaria.org/Sefer_Etz_Chaim).
